title: EBRAINS Neuromorphic Computing Infrastructure
summary: The EBRAINS initiative provides researchers with access to Europe's most powerful neuromorphic computing systems, specifically BrainScaleS and SpiNNaker. These hardware platforms are designed for brain-inspired algorithms and energy-efficient AI applications in neuroscience. Additionally, the infrastructure connects users to high-performance supercomputing centers across France, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, and other European nations for tasks like whole-brain simulations.
tldr: EBRAINS offers remote access to Europe's leading neuromorphic systems (BrainScaleS, SpiNNaker) alongside HPC resources for neuroscience research.
evidence: EBRAINS hosts Europe's most powerful large-scale neuromorphic computing systems, BrainScaleS and SpiNNaker.
These platforms open the door to innovative brain-inspired algorithms and energy-efficient AI for neuroscience.
